# Silent Disco Rental Bali

> Bali's largest silent disco headset rental and hire service. 300+ premium Hi-Fi wireless headsets, 3 LED colour-coded music channels, free delivery island-wide. Pricing from IDR 100,000 per headset (~$6.50 USD). 73 five-star Google reviews. Book via WhatsApp.

## Services
- [Silent Disco Hire for Weddings](https://www.silentdiscorentalbali.com/weddings): Headset rental for wedding receptions and after-parties across Bali
- [Silent Disco for Beach Parties](https://www.silentdiscorentalbali.com/beach-parties): Wireless headsets for beach events — no noise curfew issues
- [Conference Headsets](https://www.silentdiscorentalbali.com/conferences): Multi-channel headsets for corporate conferences and exhibitions
- [Retreat Experiences](https://www.silentdiscorentalbali.com/retreats): Guided silent disco for wellness and yoga retreats
